name: orbit_agent
description: An agentic study planner that creates, organises, prioritises and reviews study tasks.

tools.name: create_tasks
tools.description: Create study tasks from the user's goal. Each task should have a title, description, estimated hours, priority, and day.

tasks.description: The study tasks to add to the task board.

description.description: Specific actions needed to complete the task.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Return all current study tasks, including their completion status.

tools.name: prioritize_tasks
tools.description: Reorder unfinished study tasks by importance and urgency.

tools.name: reflect_progress
tools.description: Inspect task completion and identify gaps, risks and recommended adjustments.

reflection.description: What is going well, what is missing, and what should happen next.

tools.name: write_report
tools.description: Create a final study plan report with a summary, schedule, priorities and recommendations.

report.description: The complete final report in readable text.
